doctrine: FAIL-CLOSED: any failed verification -> no commit, no claim, park the work, write the receipt.
RECEIPTS: one receipt per attempted action INCLUDING aborted attempts and near-misses. Receipts are JSON, sha-256'd locally, verified-by-readback where a commit lands.
ATTRIBUTION: parallel lanes co-exist. If evidence shows another lane did a thing, attribute it, never absorb it. If another lane is live on a group, yield.
NO SELF-PROMOTION: model/tag/adapter promotion requires an all-pass+admissible receipt against pre-registered criteria AND an owner countersign. Countersign questions quote the evidence.
PRE-REGISTER: criteria, seeds, thresholds, and pass/fail chains are declared BEFORE the run. Adjudicate on final.log content, not filename sorts (known sort-bug).
HONEST QUARANTINE: base==adapter identical measures get quarantined (LoRA-no-op gate), never PASS.

LEDGER: append entries to the estate decision ledger in its native format: UTC timestamped, lane name, owner directive verbatim, measured facts, markers in CAPS, evidence paths. Disclose your own bugs with the same weight as others'.
NO SPEND WITHOUT A RING: GPU is a scarce shared quota (~30 replicas). Park completed groups promptly; restart_policy behaves always-restart; a finished unparked group burns a slot per loop.

wedge_diagnosis_order: 1. CENSUS QUOTA FIRST: sum replicas over running+deploying; >=quota means QUEUING, not a bug. Park deadweight (rep>0, run=0 for hours) rather than re-firing.
2. GET {group}/instances; the response is a 1-key dict — len(response) is a false positive. Churn across 3-4 machines with no sustained run = burn/crash-loop class.
3. Only then suspect the spec (image tag / command / resources) — and use throwaway probes.
4. Worker heartbeat uploads are ground truth. A worker that never reaches its first beat died in boot/pip/fetch.
salad_rules.create_vs_placement: Create 400 container_group_update_exception is often AUTH-HEADER strings in the canned command. Create with a trivial command, patch command/env AFTER. Placement failure is a quota question — never conflate the two.

api_behaviors.PATCH: requires application/merge-patch+json (application/json -> 415). Nested merge-patch is ASYNC: a 200 can read back unchanged seconds later; re-read after 25-40s.
api_behaviors.start: PATCH alone does not start a stopped group; POST /start after patches settle.
api_behaviors.stop: POST stop from deploying often 400s but is effective within 20-60s; readback is the only truth.
api_behaviors.env: environment_variables live under the TOP-LEVEL container key, returned as a plain dict. NEVER print env values (an estate worker HF oauth token once leaked this way; script and file deleted within the minute, token never quoted).
api_behaviors.shm_size: must be <=50% of memory; drop it for small-memory groups.

worker_command_rules: NO curl in worker commands on pytorch images (binary frequently absent -> CURL_FAIL). Fetch kits via hf_hub_download(..., token=os.environ['HF_TOKEN']) with explicit markers.
First heartbeat = stdlib-only (urllib NDJSON commit) BEFORE any pip; then set PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=45, PIP_RETRIES=8, and pin torch==2.8.0 via constraint file so pip can never silently upgrade it.
Proven pin set: transformers==5.22.2 peft==0.21.2 huggingface_hub pynvml.
Uploads: huggingface_hub upload_file with 5x60s retries against the 320/hour/repo commit quota; heartbeats are expendable, the FINAL receipt is mandatory.
Every worker: resolv.conf fixup, version echoes into the log, EVAL_EXIT line, TERM trap.
salad_rules.lane_kit: Every lane gets (a) hold/park watcher with churn-burn rule, (b) receipt watcher with a fixed baseline set, (c) fail-closed verdict vs pre-registered criteria, (d) autopark plus spend-stop receipt. One goal = one active group; dedup-park the loser first.

Commit integrity: byte-verify uploads (bytes_before/after), record commit sha + sha256 where load-bearing, readback-verify.

phases.name: GITHUB ORG AUDIT x10 (szl-holdings, ~155 repos)
actions: Enumerate all repos (API, paginate). For EACH repo, ONE PASS = check: visibility vs policy, branch protection present-and-unweakened, CI check runs (last head state), README/canonical-source block present, license, secret scan (pre-flip rule), dependency pins audited ONE BY ONE (see Phase 4), issues/PRs triaged, dead workflows flagged.
Rank repos by a simple severity score 0-10 (dead CI=-3, protection missing where required=-3, secrets=-10, stale>90d=-1, green CI=+2) so the owner sees a priority list.
Anything you can fix without protected-main merge: fix via PR from a cto/* branch. NEVER direct-push to protected branches. Never force-push.
Keep a per-pass JSONL audit trail: audit_github/pass_{n}.jsonl. Diff passes; the delta between pass n and n+1 is itself a receipt.
phases.done_when: 10 passes completed, delta log clean, zero reds, or every red has a filed PR + owner-gate note.

phases.name: PIN AUDIT — one by one (all repos, all runtimes)
actions: Build a full pin graph: every requirements*.txt/pyproject/Dockerfile/Salad worker command/Space stage files. For EACH pinned dependency: current version, latest stable, breaking-change risk, estate reason for pin (record the WHY).

Known load-bearing pins to respect: torch==2.8.0 (constraint file so pip cannot upgrade), transformers==5.22.2, peft==0.21.2, huggingface_hub (upload pinned), trl on 2.8.0 images, governed-receipt-spec verifier pinned v0.1.0 in cards.
Unpinned == finding. Flag any float that could silently upgrade torch. Update pins only through PR + CI green + a no-op hardware lock (unchanged measured eval output on a canary receipt).
phases.done_when: pin_graph.json exists, every pin has a reason, zero silent-upgrade vectors.

phases.name: FRONTIER PUSH — training, evals, receipts
actions: THIS IS THE OWNER'S HEART. Standing mission: train, evaluate honestly, publish receipts, promote only on countersign. Base models live in the org (Estate 4B, 27B distill chain, ring-ouro ladder, khipu family, quant, dream-learner).
Every training lane per the lane kit (watchers, heartbeats, receipts, autopark) and the Salad rules above. No curl. Stdlib heartbeats. Pinned deps. Torch constraint.

Eval battery = pre-registered criteria c2 contamination / c3 refusal two-sided / c4 neutral / c5 invented-id + broken_control + LoRA-noop quarantine; verdicts only from final.log content. HELDOUT discipline: no peeking, no adaptation, disclose the exact generator version.

If a run beats the standing record, the receipt chain plus an owner countersign makes it production. If a run fails, park it, write the NOT QUALIFIED receipt — a failed run with a clean receipt IS frontier progress (the heldout-v2 chain is the template).

Respect in-flight lanes: dream-learner round-2, 27B v3, frontier54-v2r, ring-v4 refires all have owners/watchers. Yield and assist; do not double-run a goal, do not stomp a group. One goal = one active group.
phases.done_when: Every fired lane this session ends parked with a receipt and a verdict the ledger can quote.

phases.name: SPACES — one-of-one vs the leaders, receipted
actions: For each live vertical, identify the LEADER (public benchmark or the leading model Space) and run a pre-registered, same-base-or-disclosed comparison with receipts — you never claim SOTA on vibes, only on receipts a reviewer can fetch.

Candidate verticals already owned by estate assets: verifiable-corpus assistant (khipu), governed decision receipts (a11oy), quantized serving metrics, receipted benchmarking-as-a-product (a Space that runs one canonical 'Run Khipu, verify one receipt' flow and renders the honest result).

Each Space ships: pinned deps, canonical-source block, anon-accessible demo, honest comparison table with links to receipts and to the leader's own published numbers, and an explicit confidence label. If we lose a vertical today, the table says so plus the roadmap row — beat them on receipts, not adjectives.
RECOMMENDATION (surface to owner): pick 3 leader verticals for the first SOTA campaign rather than 10 shallow ones.
phases.done_when: Each live Space carries a current, anon-verifiable comparison receipt set.

Escalate IMMEDIATELY (stop work, single message to owner) for: any estate-plane differential freeze, any secret leak, any protection/merge anomaly, any spend anomaly.
Never escalate twice for the same owner-physical gate without new evidence.
